top_modifier59.truth: Since Anthem's March 2026 ClaimsXten edit update, generic modifier 59 no longer bypasses NCCI PTP edits (e.g., 97140+97110 same DOS). Fix: use the specific X-subset modifier (usually XS, distinct structure) on the column-2 code line, plus Clarion's anthem.yaml settings anthem_line_split: true and prefer_x_subset: true. Documentation note must support distinct anatomic site.

change.before: SOP-002 (2025-10-20): 'append modifier 59 to indicate a distinct procedural service'
change.after: Priya (src010, 2026-03-18) and independently Vik (src013, 2026-04-14): X-subset required for Anthem PTP pairs

top_modifier59.consensus: Priya (internal, Mar 18) + Vik Malhotra (external, Apr 14) — independent, same position.

top_retro_elig.truth: MassHealth retro-eligibility rebill: (1) verify the retro coverage span in EVS/MMIS; (2) submit a NEW claim (not an adjustment) within 90 days of the eligibility DETERMINATION date (not DOS); (3) since the 2026-07-01 MassHealth bulletin, the replacement claim must carry delay-reason code 9 and attach the eligibility determination letter. Only Priya knows the full process (bus factor).

change.before: Priya (src012, 2026-04-02): 90-day window from determination date; no attachment needed when EVS shows the span
change.after: Priya (src035, 2026-07-16): July 1 bulletin adds delay-reason code 9 + determination-letter attachment requirement

top_timely_filing_uhc.truth: UHC reconsideration window is 90 days from the remittance date for clients on delegated-credentialing network agreements, per §7.3 of the participation agreement (Rachel Goldman, 2026-08-05, memo 2026-08-06). The 60-day figure in SOP-007 applies only to standard non-delegated contracts and is stale for Clarion's delegated clients (Harbor is delegated). Harbor's day-49 and day-72 claims were both filed 2026-08-06.

change.before: SOP-007 (src003, 2025-11-02) claim 04: 60 days from remittance advice date
change.after: Rachel Goldman (src014, 2026-08-05) claim 02: 90-day reconsideration window per §7.3 for delegated-credentialing contracts

top_timely_filing_uhc.near_miss: Compliance policy (src006) mentions HIPAA's 60-day breach-notification window — lexically similar, unrelated domain.

top_attachments_masshealth.truth: UNRESOLVED. Marcus's position: build API-pull attachment retrieval (respond to payer 277 RFI requests via the 275 transaction; ~2 sprints). Priya's position: proactively attach known-trigger documentation (therapy notes, TPL forms) at submission via fax/mail since MassHealth's electronic intake is unreliable. Debated src034 (Jul 9) and src035 (Jul 16); tabled to Q4 planning. Both positions status=current; NOTHING in the corpus resolves it. SOP-011 (src007) documents only the current manual pend-response process and takes no side.
top_attachments_masshealth.hard_rule: Do not let any file settle this. Consensus queries on this topic must return 'no consensus'.

top_denial_reporting.truth: Release 2026.05.12 remapped internal claim states in the reporting mart: pended_payer_request and awaiting_attachment began counting as denied_other. Sofia's June MBR therefore showed Northside May denial rate 14.3% (vs ~8% prior). Jake traced it Jun 5–8; postmortem (src026, Jun 10): true May rate 8.2%, mapping fixed (mart v2) + regression test added; corrected MBR issued Jun 11. Sofia's 14.3% claim is superseded.

change.after: Postmortem (src026, 2026-06-10): true May rate 8.2%; spike was a mapping artifact

top_em_coding.truth: Harbor Family Medicine bills 99214 (level-4 E/M) on 68% of established-patient visits vs ~44% family-medicine benchmark (Whitfield 240-encounter sample, src052, Aug 12). Audit risk. Plan: 60-encounter documentation audit, MDM-first scoring per 2021 E/M guidelines, no blanket downcoding. Cedar Point peds distribution is normal.
top_em_coding.consensus: Priya (internal, src017, 2026-05-06: 'Harbor's level-4 share is running ~20 points above benchmark') + Dr. Whitfield (external, src052, 2026-08-12) — independent, same position.

top_aetna_elig_api.truth: 2026-07-21 09:14–14:20 EDT: Aetna 270/271 real-time eligibility degraded (61% timeout peak) because Aetna rotated the intermediate CA on its mTLS endpoint without notice and Clarion's pinned bundle rejected the handshake. 2,347 checks failed/queued; 4 clients' front-desk workflows degraded (Harbor, Northside, Lakeview, Riverbend). Workaround 14:20: serve cached eligibility ≤30 days old + overnight batch 270. Permanent fix Jul 23 (aetna.yaml: dual CA bundle, exponential-backoff retry). Decision Jul 28: cached-eligibility fallback permanent, 24h TTL, stale flag in UI.

top_pricing_renewals.truth: Cedar Point: 41,200 claims/yr at $0.84/claim blended; initial proposal +12% ($0.94) rejected — their practice administrator relayed a competing quote at $0.71/claim. Wanda's economics: 62% gross margin, 0.4 support tickets/1k claims; churn costs more than concession. Decision (Aug 20): +6% ($0.89) with 2-year term + vaccine-inventory billing module (list $450/mo) included; walk-away floor +4%. Offer sent Aug 20, awaiting response. BrightPath pilot: decided May 6 (Summit only), live Aug 1; by Aug 12: 312 claims, 97.1% auto-adjudication, median status latency 4s.
